operative_context: System shall send reminder notifications before rent start and end dates with configurable timing
System shall allow users to configure notification preferences and enable/disable specific notification types
## 5.3.1 The system shall send reminder notifications before rent start date.
Notification content shall include item identifier, rental period, and rent status
System shall apply user notification preferences when sending notifications
exceptions: Some approval-related notification messages may need to remain non-optional despite user preference settings (business-critical events)
Administrative notifications to authorized users may not be subject to standard user preference filtering

The requirement's title suggests exception handling for mandatory notifications, but the PRIMARY evidence does not explicitly define what constitutes a 'mandatory' notification or how exceptions should be processed—this is a key gap. The operative context captures the baseline notification system rules; exceptions capture the emerging policy around business-critical events; gaps capture the unresolved exception handling logic.
